thesis: Near-expiry prediction contracts can be mispriced when an authoritative public datum already determines or tightly constrains settlement.
trigger: The exact settlement rule maps to a named, queryable public source.
entry_rule: Trade only when authoritative data and the exact rule imply probability above the after-cost threshold.
exit_rule: Settlement, rule invalidation, target, stop, or 72-hour time stop.
sizing_hints: Use binary fractional Kelly and never substitute a context source for the settlement source.
